dedupe_keys.name: improving site dependent power curve prediction accuracy using regression trees

description: Sarah Barber and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The model trains AdaBoost regression trees using 8,000 ten-minute ASHES simulations of the NREL 5 MW turbine, including site-specific inflow features. The reported configuration limits tree depth to eight and evaluates fifty test cases, with a threefold RMSE improvement in the stated comparison. A related Brazil field-data extension and presentation belong to this research programme. Their inclusion does not establish identical trained models or universal improvement at new sites. Public source code and trained-model availability remain unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
